newsitem.title: USA: D&P reaffirms most American Electric unit ratings.
newsitem.headline: D&P reaffirms most American Electric unit ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said on Friday it reaffirmed the credit ratings of American Electric Power Co Inc's Appalachian Power Co, Columbus Southern Power Co and Ohio Power Co, excluding the ratings for the preferred stock of Appalachian Power and Ohio Power.
Duff & Phelps said it downgraded the preferred stock of Appalachian Power and Ohio Power following recent redemptions and the expected debt financings needed to fund these redemptions.

The preferred stock downgrades reflect only the strategic proportional changes in each of the two companies' capital structures and not the recent financial performance or recently announced participation of the parent company in a bid to acquire Yorkshire Electricity Group Plc.
The acquisition is not expected to have a significant impact on Appalachian Power, Columbus Southern Power or Ohio Power.
Appalachian Power's preferred stock was downgraded to Triple B Plus from Single A Minus. Ohio Power's preferred was lowered to Triple B from Triple B Plus.
Ratings were reaffirmed on Appalachian Power's first mortgage bonds at Single A, junior subordinated deferred interest debentures at Single A Minus and commercial paper at D One.

Columbus Southern's ratings remain unchanged at Single A Minus for first mortgage bonds; Triple B Plus for junior subordinated deferred interest debentures and preferred stock, and D One Minus for commercial paper.
Ohio Power's ratings were reaffirmed at Single A for first mortgage bonds; Triple B Plus for debentures and junior subordinated deferred interest debentures, and D One for commercial paper.
